name: Sylvester
source:
An aggressive, cantankerous hallucination, constructed by Manson's subconscious. While sexually uninvolved in Object Ward, he engages with [Spoiler]Sharpay and Father in Agatha's Agony.[/spoiler] 

Formerly Manson's blanket.
